title: Guardian Protocol sightings document, version 0.2
description: What one organization's sensor saw, as counts with no content in them. See spec/sightings-0.2.md for the reasoning behind each constraint. This file is normative for shape; the prose is normative for meaning.

schema_version.description: Readers must also accept 0.1, where source is absent and means live.

org.description: A pseudonym the member chooses. Never a company name or a domain.

sensor_version.description: Constrained because a caller supplies it, so without a shape it is a free text channel.

rules_version.description: Which rule set was running. Required, and never a placeholder.

pattern.description: Registry pattern identifier. An unrecognised one is kept and counted.

action.description: What the sensor did. Not a severity.

hour.description: UTC hour, truncated. Anything finer is close to a unique identifier.

count.description: Detections of that pattern, action, hour and source.

source.description: Real traffic, or a fire drill the member ran against themselves. Absent in 0.1, where it means live.
